name: Advanced College Football Composite (ACFC) Top 25 Ranking Engine
description: v0.5.0: Week 3 data release. New scripts/update-week.js pulls a completed week from ESPN (scoreboard, AP/Coaches polls, FPI) and rewrites data.js: 26 Week 3 team-games appended with kickoff rank tags, record/sam/top-25 wins/keyLoss/bestWin derived, polls moved to the 2026-09-20 release, previousRank set to the pre-update ACFC rank, and sor/gameControl/sos/offEfficiency/defEfficiency quantile-mapped onto ESPN FPI ordering (every record cross-checked against ESPN FPI W-L). Matchup engine now rounds the margin once so home field shows as 2-3 points, not 4. The Colley check now asserts the real margin-free property instead of an ordering Colley does not guarantee.

versioningProtocol.minor: +0.1: Algorithmic weight tweaks, UI styling refinements, roster/schedule adjustments, heuristic updates
versioningProtocol.major: +1.0: New ranking data models, backend API integration, multi-season archives, or architectural changes
